latest_action.text: Introduction and first reading, referred to Taxes

bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to taxation; tax increment financing; extending the authority for the city of Fridley to transfer tax increment; amending Laws 2023, chapter 64, article 8, section 11, subdivision 5.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Laws 2023, chapter 64, article 8, section 11, subdivision 5, is amended to read:

Subd. 5.
Expiration.
The authority to make transfers under subdivision 1 expires December 31, [-2027-][+ 2031+].

[+EFFECTIVE DATE.+]

[+This section is effective the day after the governing body of the city of Fridley and its chief clerical officer comply with the requirements of Minnesota Statutes, section 645.021, subdivisions 2 and 3. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to taxation; tax increment financing; extending the authority for the city of Fridley to transfer tax increment; amending Laws 2023, chapter 64, article 8, section 11, subdivision 5.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Laws 2023, chapter 64, article 8, section 11, subdivision 5, is amended to read:

Subd. 5.
Expiration.
The authority to make transfers under subdivision 1 expires December 31, 2031.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective the day after the governing body of the city of Fridley and its chief clerical officer comply with the requirements of Minnesota Statutes, section 645.021, subdivisions 2 and 3.
additions: This section is effective the day after the governing body of the city of Fridley and its chief clerical officer comply with the requirements of Minnesota Statutes, section 645.021, subdivisions 2 and 3.
